policy: Audit only. Registration numbers, EX history, and evidence are not changed. Name normalization is used only to classify existing values; it never merges identities or infers registration numbers.

collision.rule: One registrationNo maps to multiple normalized racer names; do not merge or rewrite.

aliasCandidate.rule: One registrationNo has multiple raw spellings but one normalized name; retain existing values and review before any registry normalization.

safeSameRacer.rule: One normalized name and complete registration provenance for every registered appearance.

sameNameMultipleRegistrationNo.rule: One normalized name maps to multiple registration numbers. Treat as a candidate only; do not merge by name.

nextSteps: Preserve all current registrationNo values; this audit does not authorize correction or identity merging.
Carry sourceFetchedAt and provenance from official detail collection into racer-level registration sources.
Review collision and same-name-multiple-registration candidates against dated official records before any registry change.
Keep racer-evidence aggregation keyed by registrationNo only after provenance is complete.
